name: Rocky Mountain Human Services: veteran housing help (SSVF)
description: VA-funded Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF, grant 20-CO-020): case management, help keeping a home, rapid rehousing and short-term financial help for low-income veteran households. Serves: Adams County, Alamosa County, Arapahoe County, Archuleta County, Baca County, Bent County, Boulder County, Broomfield County, Chaffee County, Cheyenne County, Clear Creek County, Conejos County and 52 more.
next_step: Call SSVF intake with your county and housing situation: whether you are homeless now or at risk of losing housing, and who lives with you. A second intake number is listed: 719-323-2600.
constraints: Serves only the areas listed; check that yours is included. Veteran-household, income and housing-status screening applies.
County and intake details come from VA’s FY26 SSVF provider intake list; confirm current service when calling.

source_evidence.scope: County coverage and SSVF intake; Contacts worksheet row 168
